title: Outlook: new Copilot entry point in classic Outlook
summary: The briefing accurately reports Microsoft's rollout windows, default availability and unchanged licensing requirements. The licensing control's admin path and Microsoft Graph operation are documented, and the page correctly avoids presenting licence assignment as a way to hide the entry point.

In the admin center, go to the Billing > Licenses page.
